tldr: The Sun through the 11th house brings attention to friends, groups, community, networks, and future plans.
body:
When the Sun moves through your 11th house, it brings attention to friends, groups, audience, networks, community, hopes, and where you belong. You may notice who you are connected to, which groups still feel alive, and what kind of future you want to be part of.

Something may feel more visible, energizing, exposed, or ready to be claimed. It can help you notice what needs more life, honesty, or direct attention.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for seeing where belonging supports you and where it has become performative.

The caution: Watch for needing validation so badly that you miss what actually feels true. The risk is staying attached to a group, plan, or audience that no longer fits.

The Sun moves through this house for about a month. Use the visibility well. Put attention where it gives you more life, not just more approval.
